name: CAPTCHA solving service
description: Sends CAPTCHAs to a solving service you have an account with (2Captcha, Anti-Captcha, CapSolver or CapMonster Cloud). It never sees personal details: only the site's CAPTCHA key and a cleaned page address, or a cropped picture of the puzzle with every form field and saved detail blacked out. The account key is set on the CAPTCHAs page and given to this plugin only while it solves. If the service can't solve it, a person can.
author: OpenOptOut contributors

name: Generic SMTP / IMAP Email Provider
description: A server-agnostic email provider: sends via SMTP and reads confirmations via IMAP against ANY server the operator configures (host, port, TLS). Use it for self-hosted / on-premises mail, or any provider without a dedicated plugin. No server is hardcoded — the SMTP/IMAP host and port come from the stored account settings. Trusted email-provider class; host inspects for hidden recipients and enforces the recipient at send time.
author: OpenOptOut

name: Gmail Email Provider
description: Sends opt-out emails and reads confirmations via the Gmail API using OAuth 2.0. A reference email-provider plugin. Trusted class: it sends member identifiers to Gmail, so it declares read_pii + network, and the host inspects it for hidden recipients and enforces the actual recipient at send time.
author: OpenOptOut

name: Outlook / Microsoft 365 Email Provider
description: Sends opt-out emails and reads confirmations via Microsoft Graph using OAuth 2.0. Trusted email-provider class; host inspects for hidden recipients and enforces the recipient at send time.
author: OpenOptOut

name: Yahoo Mail
description: Yahoo Mail email provider. The person signs in with Yahoo (OAuth 2.0); mail is sent over Yahoo's SMTP and read over its IMAP with that sign-in token (SASL OAUTHBEARER). No app passwords. Reads confirmation links from message bodies without marking them read. Trusted email-provider class; host inspects for hidden recipients and enforces the recipient at send time.
author: OpenOptOut
